title: The boy who walked to the 7-Eleven
opening: The house sends a boy three quarters of a mile for milk. The road is quiet enough to count each step.

scenes.open_space: Who wrote the list is undecided. Let the player describe what the porch smells like.

cues.prompt: Optional: ask the player what else is in his pocket; do not assert an answer for them.

scenes.seed: At the porch he checks his pockets: coins, a key, and a shopping list written in someone else's hand.
Milk. Matches. A third item has been rubbed out, but the pressure of the pen remains.
The erased word might be a name. It might be 'home'. No one here can tell him which.

scenes.open_space: The walk may accumulate observations without forcing a revelation.

cues.prompt: Optional night-road ambience; no automatic audio playback.

scenes.seed: The 7-Eleven sign hums at the end of the road. Behind him, the house has one lit window.
The clerk looks at the list, then at the boy. 'We don't sell that here anymore.'
He pays for milk and matches. The register prints three items.

scenes.open_space: The receipt's meaning belongs to this take; a future take may disagree without rewriting it.
scenes.seed: The third line is blank. The date is tomorrow. Outside, the house's lit window goes dark.
